title: CIA Character Record Schema
rules: Record first/last as first/last currently recovered evidence, never lifetime endpoints unless independently established.
Do not infer motive, diagnosis, criminality, supernatural status or permanent moral essence from a role label.
Project-symbolic debt, karmic debt and spiritual accounting are not legal or financial liabilities unless independently established.
Association is typed: co-presence is weaker than direct interaction, and direct interaction is weaker than an explicit relationship claim.
Keep user-supplied alias clues separate from independently recovered aliases.
A role can change; retain old and new states with dates instead of overwriting history.
